description_en: Adds program list information for a production studio
description_zh: 添加导播台节目列表信息
name: AddCasterEpisodeGroupContent

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The parameter value is generated by the client. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests and is up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Sets the properties of the production studio program. The value is a JSON string. The parameters use the upper camel case format. The property information is described as follows: CallbackUrl: the callback URL. SideOutputUrl: the custom bypass output URL. RepeatNum: the number of repetitions. A value of 0 indicates no loop, and a value of -1 indicates an infinite loop. StartTime: the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. DomainName: the domain name. Items: the program list. - ItemName: the program name. - VodUrl: the URL of the video-on-demand (VOD) file. This parameter is used only when the resource is a video file and the video file is not imported to the media asset library. MP4, FLV, and TS formats are supported
parameters.help_zh: 设置导播台节目属性。JSON字符串格式。参数采用首字母大写驼峰格式。属性信息说明如下： CallbackUrl：用户回调地址。 SideOutputUrl： 用户自定义旁路输出地址。 RepeatNum：重复次数。0表示不循环，-1表示无限循环。 StartTime：起始时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 DomainName：域名。 Items：节目列表。 - ItemName：节目名称。 - VodUrl：点播文件地址，当且仅当资源为文件视频，且视频文件未导入素材库时使用，支持MP4、FLV、TS格式。
parameters.name: content

ProgramId.description_en: The program ID. It can be used as a request parameter for creating or adding program items, deleting program items, querying program items, editing programs, deleting programs, querying programs, starting programs, and stopping programs
ProgramId.description_zh: 节目单ID。可作为创建或添加节目单项，删除节目单项，查询节目单项，编辑节目单，删除节目单，查询节目单，启动节目单，停止节目单的请求参数
